comment.body:
Thanks for confirming that PowerToys is still running when the mappings fail outside its own windows. Please provide.

1. One exact harmless key-to-key remap and numbered tests in PowerToys Settings, Notepad, and one other affected application.
2. Whether PowerToys and each target application are running as administrator under the same Windows user.
3. The current PowerToys version.
4. Immediately after reproducing outside PowerToys, add a comment containing `/bugreport` for a fresh diagnostic ZIP.

This will distinguish a hook/engine startup failure from an integrity-level or application-specific boundary.
